sitecheck.meta_title: Free website, SEO and security analyzer
sitecheck.meta_description: Check HTTP, TLS, security headers, SEO, robots.txt and sitemap.xml with a free, actionable report.
sitecheck.title: Your website, seen from outside.
sitecheck.description: Enter a public address and get a clear checklist for availability, TLS, headers, SEO and indexing. No invasive crawler or stored result.
sitecheck.input_hint: The analysis accesses only the submitted URL, robots.txt and sitemap.xml.
sitecheck.loading_note: Validating the target and requesting its public resources. This may take a few seconds.
sitecheck.error_title: The analysis could not be completed
sitecheck.privacy_note: The URL is used only during this analysis. We create no account, history or public link and never send the analyzed address to Analytics.
sitecheck.limitations_note: This report observes public signals from Belluzzi infrastructure. It does not replace a security audit, penetration test, Search Console or real-user monitoring.

errors.INVALID_URL: Enter a valid domain or HTTP/HTTPS URL without a username or password.
errors.TARGET_BLOCKED: The target points to a private, local or reserved network and was blocked for safety.
errors.PORT_NOT_ALLOWED: SiteCheck accepts only the standard public ports 80 and 443.
errors.TIMEOUT: The website took longer than the safe response limit.
errors.RESPONSE_TOO_LARGE: The response exceeded this analysis safety limit.
errors.RATE_LIMITED: Too many analyses were requested from this address. Wait and try again.
errors.BUSY: SiteCheck is handling other analyses. Try again in a few seconds.
errors.TARGET_UNREACHABLE: The target did not respond, returned an invalid redirect or closed the connection.

http_status.title: Final HTTP response
http_status.recommendation: The main page should respond successfully, normally with a 2xx status.

http_redirects.title: Redirect chain
http_redirects.recommendation: Keep the chain short to reduce latency and avoid loops or unexpected destinations.

http_response_time.title: Observed response time
http_response_time.recommendation: Times above two seconds deserve investigation, considering this measurement comes from one server.

tls_enabled.title: HTTPS connection
tls_enabled.recommendation: The final destination should use HTTPS to protect transport integrity and privacy.

tls_validity.title: Certificate validity
tls_validity.recommendation: Use a trusted certificate and renew it before fewer than 30 days remain.

header_csp.title: Content Security Policy
header_csp.recommendation: Define a CSP compatible with the site to reduce unauthorized content execution.

header_hsts.title: HTTP Strict Transport Security
header_hsts.recommendation: On HTTPS sites, HSTS tells browsers to avoid future unencrypted connections.

header_frame.title: Frame protection
header_frame.recommendation: Use CSP frame-ancestors or X-Frame-Options when the site does not need to be embedded.

header_nosniff.title: Content type protection
header_nosniff.recommendation: Send X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff to prevent ambiguous file interpretation.

header_referrer.title: Referrer policy
header_referrer.recommendation: Set Referrer-Policy to control which information accompanies external links.

header_permissions.title: Permissions policy
header_permissions.recommendation: Restrict camera, microphone, geolocation and other capabilities the site does not use.

header_cache.title: Cache policy
header_cache.recommendation: Declare Cache-Control according to content sensitivity and update frequency.

header_cookies.title: Cookie attributes
header_cookies.recommendation: Sensitive cookies should use Secure, HttpOnly and SameSite. Cookie-free sites receive an informational result.

seo_title.title: Page title
seo_title.recommendation: Use a unique, descriptive title; 10 to 70 characters is only a practical reference.

seo_description.title: Meta description
seo_description.recommendation: Summarize the page usefully. Missing, very short or long descriptions deserve review.

seo_canonical.title: Canonical URL
seo_canonical.recommendation: Declare a valid HTTP/HTTPS canonical to identify the preferred version of this page.

seo_robots.title: Page robots directive
seo_robots.recommendation: Confirm that noindex is intentional; without a directive, search crawlers assume indexing is allowed.

seo_viewport.title: Responsive viewport
seo_viewport.recommendation: Include the viewport meta tag so the page renders correctly on mobile devices.

seo_language.title: Document language
seo_language.recommendation: Declare lang on the HTML element for accessibility and content understanding.

seo_hreflang.title: Language alternatives
seo_hreflang.recommendation: Multilingual sites can use hreflang; single-language sites do not need it.

seo_opengraph.title: Open Graph metadata
seo_opengraph.recommendation: Open Graph title, description and image improve link previews when sharing.

seo_h1.title: Main H1 heading
seo_h1.recommendation: A page generally benefits from one clear H1. No H1 or multiple H1s require contextual review.

indexing_robots.title: robots.txt file
indexing_robots.recommendation: Provide a valid robots.txt on the final origin, even if it only allows crawling.

indexing_sitemap.title: sitemap.xml file
indexing_sitemap.recommendation: Provide a valid sitemap or sitemap index to improve URL discovery.
